mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees and overcast at Badger Prairie County Park. The moon is in its first quarter, and the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Starting September 23, the city is beginning chip seal treatments on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and Liberty Business Park. Also, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects on October 5.

There is plenty to do today, including the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, and the Bike the Barns fundraiser. Tomorrow, you can catch a yoga class at Insight Wellness.
In a notable incident on September 5, local officers encountered a strange situation where multiple vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields as part of a viral social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available right now.
